business_problem: Digitizing the construction industry Business-to-business (B2B) digital services company uses a full suite of MongoDB offerings to develop solutions that serve the construction industry.
solution_summary: Digitizing the construction industry Business-to-business (B2B) digital services company uses a full suite of MongoDB offerings to develop solutions that serve the construction industry. iConstruye simplified its database architecture by migrating to MongoDB Atlas. The company’s products streamline supply chain operations, from requesting contract services all the way to making payments. In 2017, the company started using MongoDB Community Edition, a self-managed document database, to meet its database needs. Since then, MongoDB’s document model has helped the company simplify development and boost developer productivity. “MongoDB helps customers like us gain new capabilities as technology evolves,” said Matías Vázquez, vice president of engineering at iConstruye. Adopting Atlas Search and Vector Search helped the company greatly simplify its search architecture.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
solution_components.role: Retrieves semantically relevant context from iConstruye's data for AI, search, and recommendation workflows.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Provides relevance-based text retrieval across iConstruye's documents and application data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational, document, and context data behind iConstruye's AI-powered search and assistant experiences.

data_flow: Business documents, tickets, records, and other operational content stay in MongoDB Atlas Vector Search and MongoDB Atlas Search, where search indexes or vector embeddings are built and then queried in real time to supply grounded results to applications, assistants, or discovery features. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS.
business_outcome: 20% reduction in time to market 25% increase in deployment frequency rate Enhanced efficiency
architecture_clues: Vector search is part of the retrieval layer for semantic or generative-AI use cases.
AI agents or assistants are layered on top of the MongoDB data platform.
